title: Fix it: turn query parameters into a typed search request
basics: HTTP query parameters always arrive as text, even when they look like numbers. `as Number` and `as Boolean` convert text into those types: `"2" as Number` is the Number 2. A value that cannot be converted, or is missing, makes the coercion fail.
prompt:
The script in the editor is **almost** right. It passes on the sample and fails on a case you cannot see.

The original task was:

An API receives search parameters as an object of Strings: `page`, `size`, `inStock` and `q`. The search engine wants real types:

- `page`: a Number, 1 if not given,
- `size`: a Number, 20 if not given,
- `inStock`: a Boolean, `false` if not given,
- `q`: the text as it is, `null` if not given.

Find what is wrong and fix it. You can press Run to see what it currently does.
starter:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
{
  page: (payload.page default "1") as Number,
  size: (payload.size default "20") as Number,
  inStock: payload.inStock default false,
  q: payload.q
}
hints: Run it on the sample first. If the sample looks right, the bug only shows on data the sample does not contain.
Ask what kind of input would break this — an empty list, a missing field, a value ordered differently.
coerces the page and size but not inStock, so "true" stays a String
solution:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
{
  page: (payload.page default "1") as Number,
  size: (payload.size default "20") as Number,
  inStock: (payload.inStock default "false") as Boolean,
  q: payload.q
}

mustFail.script:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
{
  page: (payload.page default "1") as Number,
  size: (payload.size default "20") as Number,
  inStock: payload.inStock default false,
  q: payload.q
}

explanation.approach: Every parameter is a String, including "true" and "50". Coercing turns them into real values. A missing parameter is null, so give the fallback first, as text, and coerce the result. Writing the fallback after the coercion also works in DataWeave, because `default` catches a failed coercion, but putting it first says what you mean.

snippets.label: Query values are text
snippets.note: It looks like a number, but it is a String until coerced.

snippets.label: A missing value cannot be coerced
Fallback, then coerce
snippets.note: The fallback is used, and it coerces cleanly.
